title: Interim CDC guidance for polio vaccination for travel to and from countries affected by wild poliovirus.
ehr_evidence: This report provides an update on CDC policy for polio vaccination of travelers for health protection; the document is a CDC/MMWR interim guidance statement based on epidemiological and scientific literature rather than an electronic health record or individual-level database.
summary: A 2014 CDC MMWR interim guidance document providing recommendations for polio vaccination (IPV or OPV) of travelers to and from countries with active wild poliovirus (WPV) transmission.
study_design: guidance document / policy statement (not an original empirical study)
data_source_type: guidance document based on epidemiological and scientific literature
population: travelers (infants, children, and adults) to or from countries with active WPV circulation, including long-term residents, immigrants, and refugees
exposure_domain: polio vaccination (IPV/OPV) for travel to polio-affected countries
limitations: Not an empirical study; no primary data analysis, effect sizes, or statistical results are reported.
Recommendations are time-sensitive and subject to change as the WHO public health emergency is reassessed.
